title: Durable Local Run History
reason: The formal Run envelope and public OptimizationSolution model now exist, but current saved scenarios still treat result payloads primarily as compactable caches. The next highest-value gap is to make local Run history queryable and user-visible while retaining the same repository and no-server policy.
not_recommended_yet: PostgreSQL/PostGIS repository foundation: no sharing, sync, or remote durable-run requirement has been established.
Complex scenario branching UX: the pure branch operation exists and can be productized after Run lineage is visible.
Artifact/report evidence storage: ReportDefinition and artifact references exist, but durable local Run lineage should be exercised first.
constraints: do not add authentication or server persistence
